exercises.instruction: Pick the word that fits the meaning.

items.prompt: Ev çok güzel, ___ ucuz. (on top of that)
items.explanation: A plus on a plus, one more argument on top — üstelik.
Snow is more than just cold. Beyond expectations — hatta.

items.say: Ev pahalı. Bununla birlikte konumu harika.
items.explanation: A minus, then a plus — a turn. Nevertheless — bununla birlikte.
The word looks like “along with this,” but it means “nevertheless.”

exercises.instruction: Which Turkish word is behind the English sentence?

entries.text: Pretty, and cheap on top of that!
Expensive, and slow on top of that.
It was hard. Nevertheless, we made it.
Expensive. Still, the neighborhood is great.

items.explanation: Ayrıca — one more item, üstelik — one more argument in the same direction, hatta — even, bununla birlikte — nevertheless.

exercises.instruction: Put the word into the landing page text.

items.text: Kliniğimiz Kızılay'da. ___ cumartesi günleri de açığız.
items.translation: Our clinic is in Kızılay. In addition, we're also open on Saturdays.
items.say: Kliniğimiz Kızılay'da. Ayrıca cumartesi günleri de açığız.
items.explanation: One more item of the same weight — ayrıca.

items.translation: The project was very hard; nevertheless, we finished on time.
items.say: Proje çok zordu; bununla birlikte zamanında bitirdik.
items.explanation: Hard — but we made it. A turn — bununla birlikte.
The director is the least expected guest. Hatta, often together with bile.

items.translation: This restaurant is expensive, and on top of that the food is cold.
items.say: Bu restoran pahalı, üstelik yemekleri soğuk.
items.explanation: A minus on a minus, the finishing argument — üstelik.

items.translation: The house is very pretty, and cheap on top of that.
items.explanation: A plus on a plus — üstelik.

items.translation: The house is expensive. Nevertheless, the location is excellent.
items.say: Ev pahalı. Bununla birlikte konumu harika.
items.explanation: A minus, then a plus — bununla birlikte.

items.translation: I know him — in fact, we went to the same school.
items.say: Onu tanıyorum, hatta aynı okulda okuduk.
items.explanation: The second part is stronger than the first — hatta.

exercises.instruction: Landing page editor: fill in five blanks in the dental clinic's text.
exercises.description: Copy for a clinic in Ankara. Each blank gets one of the lesson's words. The client reacts to every choice.

items.explanation: One more plus of the same weight: central, and the metro's close by too.
Experienced, and friendly on top of that — üstelik.
A free appointment is more than “affordable.” Hatta.
A small clinic — and still hundreds of patients. A turn.
One more schedule item — ayrıca.

items.prompt: Which word doesn't add, but contrasts?
items.explanation: Bununla birlikte — “nevertheless.” The other three add.

items.statement: “Bununla beraber” means the same as “bununla birlikte.”
items.explanation: They're synonyms: both mean “nevertheless, at the same time.”

items.prompt: Which word often pairs up with bile?
items.explanation: Hatta ... bile — “even.”
“I'm tired, I can't even stand” — the second part is stronger. Hatta.

items.translation: The weather was nice; nevertheless, we didn't go in the sea.
items.say: Hava güzeldi; bununla birlikte denize girmedik.
items.explanation: Nice weather, but we didn't swim — a turn.
